title: 第1514章 三方出手第1513章 恼羞成怒的林风海
slug: 太古封神第1516章直接镇压
lines: 随着剑道先天道胎的力量融入，秦云的修为瞬间攀升到了第二境的程度。
再加上念神加持，修为已经超过了第二境，逼近第三境了。
“竟然达到接近第三境的修为层次了……难怪你能斩杀他们五人。”林风海面色沉冷，杀意更加浓烈了。
秦云展现出来的潜力，已经让他感受到了威胁。
若是让秦云继续活下去的话，必然会成为北源林族未来的威胁。
林风海右手施加力量。
无形之力扣在秦云身上，五指捏着秦云肩部等位置，整个肩部发出咔嚓的脆响声。
“身躯这么硬，竟然还走了体道的路，并且以体道淬炼了道主之躯，只是可惜了，体道早已没有了传承。”
“要是有传承在的话，此子的体魄之强，我都不一定能破开。”
林风海绷着脸看着秦云。
越是了解秦云的底子，秦云给他和北源林族带来的威胁就越大。
这时！
秦云举起了星辰本源之剑。
无尽的星空浮现而出，密密麻麻的星辰缓缓呈现。
“此剑竟然是宝物，能让他的力量暴增，这力量起码堪比第四境了。可惜，第四境还是太弱了。”
林风海冷哼。
可下一刻，那些星辰都泛起了星芒。
秦云的身上也泛起了同样的星芒，半步大道主层次的星辰剑道呈现而出，无尽的星空和星辰，全部融入其中。
林风海的脸色顿时变了，他竟然感受到了威胁。
秦云持剑斩出！
所有星辰化作了霸道至极的一剑，爆发出来的锋芒贯穿了无形的手，以及力量屏障。
林风海的脸色当场就变了。
秦云这一击的力量，竟然将他的力量屏障，还有无形之手都摧毁了不说，他的食指还被一道剑芒划伤了。
右手食指上，伤口很浅，但却有鲜血缓缓流淌而出。
林风海绷着脸看着秦云，此时此刻他只有一个想法，那就是宰了秦云，千万不要让秦云活下去。
至于折磨秦云……
林风海不想这么做了，他怕秦云会逃掉。
“你可以死了！”林风海催动全部力量，四周的空间全部被禁锢了，无以伦比的威能覆盖而下。
“想杀我？没那么容易。”秦云沉声说道。
一道身影横空而来，第六境的气息绽放而出，赫然正是琉璃神尸，它直接一拳砸向林风海。
什么……
content_en:
With the integration of the power of the sword's innate Tao embryo, Qin Yun's cultivation level instantly climbed to the second level.
Coupled with the blessing of Nian Shen, his cultivation has surpassed the second level and is approaching the third level.
"You have reached a cultivation level close to the third realm... No wonder you were able to kill five of them." Lin Fenghai's face was cold, and his murderous intention became even stronger.
Qin Yun's potential has already made him feel threatened.
If Qin Yun is allowed to continue to live, he will definitely become a threat to the future of the Beiyuan Lin Clan.
Lin Fenghai exerted force with his right hand.
Invisible force clasped Qin Yun's body, and his five fingers pinched Qin Yun's shoulders and other places, and the whole shoulder made a crisp sound.
"With such a hard body, he actually took the path of the body path and tempered the body of the Tao master with the body path. It's just a pity that the body path has long been passed down."
"If there is an inheritance, I may not be able to break through this boy's physical strength."
Lin Fenghai looked at Qin Yun with a sullen face.
The more he understands Qin Yun's background, the greater the threat Qin Yun poses to him and the Beiyuan Forest Clan.
At this time!
Qin Yun raised the Sword of Star Origin.
The endless starry sky emerged, and the dense stars slowly appeared.
"This sword turns out to be a treasure that can increase his power dramatically. This power is at least comparable to that of the fourth realm. Unfortunately, the fourth realm is still too weak."
Lin Fenghai snorted coldly.
But the next moment, those stars glowed with starlight.
The same starlight also appeared on Qin Yun's body, and the Star Sword Dao at the main level of the Half-Step Avenue appeared, and the endless starry sky and stars were all integrated into it.
Lin Fenghai's expression suddenly changed, and he actually felt threatened.
Qin Yun slashes out with his sword!
All the stars turned into an extremely domineering sword, and the sharp edge that exploded penetrated the invisible hand and the power barrier.
Lin Fenghai's expression changed on the spot.
The power of Qin Yun's blow actually destroyed his power barrier and invisible hand. Not to mention, his index finger was scratched by a sword light.
The wound on the index finger of his right hand was very shallow, but blood slowly flowed out.
Lin Fenghai looked at Qin Yun with a sullen face. At this moment, he had only one thought, which was to kill Qin Yun and never let Qin Yun live.
As for torturing Qin Yun...
Lin Fenghai didn't want to do this anymore because he was afraid Qin Yun would escape.
"You can die!" Lin Fenghai mobilized all his power, and the surrounding space was all imprisoned, covered with unparalleled power.
"Want to kill me? It's not that easy." Qin Yun said in a deep voice.
A figure came across the sky, and the aura of the sixth realm bloomed out. It was the Liuli Divine Corpse, and it punched Lin Fenghai directly.
What……
